title: Counting in logarithmic space
summary: We study the class $\#\mathsf{L}$ of functions counting accepting paths of non-deterministic log-space Turing machines and construct methods to prove containment in $\#\mathsf{L}$. We prove that a large number of classical combinatorial and number theoretic functions belong to this class: classical functions from enumerative combinatorics (multinomial coefficients, Catalan numbers, linear extensions of trees, Stirling numbers, etc), algebraic combinatorics (number of standard Young tableaux, etc), discrete geometry, number theoretic functions, representation theoretic multiplicities in a…
